title: questlog decisions.json
description: Decision log. The approval gate: agent proposes (approved:false), only founder action flips to true. Frozen against Build Plan Section 1.3.

plain.description: OPTIONAL plain-register restatement of rationale+impact. Feeds the Plain English toggle.

standing.description: OPTIONAL. true = a policy ruling that legitimately never becomes a milestone (for example: approvals happen in chat). An APPROVED decision with an empty relatedMilestoneIds and no standing flag is an ORPHAN — unrecorded planned work — and is surfaced at session start and nudged at stop. Absent or false = ordinary decision. Never gates a write: decision capture is sacred.

unclear.description: OPTIONAL. true = founder flagged this decision as unclear. Absent or false = not flagged.

unclearAt.description: OPTIONAL. REQUIRED valid timestamp when unclear===true; null/absent otherwise (enforced by validate.mjs).

unclearDispatchId.description: OPTIONAL. Set (with unclearDispatchedAt) when a dispatch consumes this standing unclear flag; both-or-neither.

unclearDispatchedAt.description: OPTIONAL. ISO timestamp the flag was dispatched; both-or-neither with unclearDispatchId.

allOf.description: Invariant: approved === true  <=>  status === approved (and approvedAt set).
